_comment: Manifest for api_bugfix_regression.yml. Bug-fix API tests live under tests/regression/ and run only here; api-testing.yml ignores tests/regression/ on every PR. Fields: label = job name `api_regression / <label>`; target = pytest args, relative to tests/api-testing; server_env = KEY=VALUE pairs the server starts with; category = the junit artifact category parse-api-junit.py reads. A file under tests/regression/ with no shard fails generate_matrix. Several shards may name one file only with different server_env (a flag matrix).

shards.label: default
shards._comment: Files that need no server env of their own.

shards.label: otlp_grpc_backpressure
shards._comment: A free-space requirement no runner meets keeps the disk circuit breaker tripped.

shards.label: sqlite_meta_invalid_utf8
shards._comment: Spawns and restarts its own server from the repo's debug binary.

shards.label: promql_mixed_case_name
shards._comment: openobserve#13926 only reproduces when stream names keep their case.

shards.label: multialert_notify_cap
shards._comment: openobserve#14407 needs a per-evaluation notification cap, which defaults to 0 (unlimited).
